inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: 136.414M shares on the 10-Q cover (2026-07-09) + 0.296M dilutive RSU/PSU adjustment from the Q1 FY2027 EPS note. Held FLAT because SBC (plus withholding taxes) is expensed in the flows; charging dilution too would double-count. FY2026 weighted diluted count was 145.8M -- the ~9M reduction is Q4 FY26 / Q1 FY27 buybacks and is already in the anchor.
inputs.sbc_source: SEC XBRL FY2026 10-K (FYE 2026-03-31): ShareBasedCompensation cash-flow add-back $44.835M + PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation $8.410M (financing). DECK publishes no adjusted-EBITDA reconciliation with a combined figure, so the two lines are summed.
inputs.wacc_rationale: USD flows, USD rate. Risk-free 4.25% (10y UST, Sep-2026) + beta 1.05 x ERP 5.0% = 9.5% cost of equity; no debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Same 9.5% in every scenario -- fashion-cycle and HOKA-deceleration risk are carried in the bear scenario path and its 25% weight, not stacked on as a rate premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: US GAAP ASC 842: operating lease cost ($88.9M FY2026) sits inside SG&A and therefore inside EBITDA and the flows. Lease liabilities ($472.3M at 2026-06-30) are therefore NOT added to net debt, and lease_cost_pct_path is 0 -- one treatment, charged once.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon (routing: consumer-brand operating company, moderately cyclical; dcf-methods SKILL.md row 1/2). First valuation of DECK -- no prior DCF, no MEMORY entry. Owner FCF FY2026 = reported FCF 1,097.3 (OCF 1,182.0 - capex 84.6) - SBC incl. withholding 53.2 - interest income 63.6 = 980.5. Interest income stripped because net cash (1.60B) > 1x the FCF base. FY2026 cash tax paid was only 17.7% of pretax (234.3M), versus 27.6% in FY2025 and a 22.8% book ETR -- timing, not structure, so the path runs at 23%. Year-1 EBITDA margin anchored to FY2027 guidance (revenue $5.86-5.91B, EPS $7.35-7.50, gross margin ~56.5% vs 57.7% on a 12.5% effective tariff rate, no refunds assumed): implied operating margin ~21.2%, EBITDA ex-SBC ~23.4% vs 25.3% in FY2026. Working capital is a genuine drag for a wholesale/DTC footwear distributor (AR 319 + inventory 487 - AP 385 = 421M at FYE, ~7.7% of revenue), so wc_capture is -8%. Buybacks: a heavy repurchaser ($1,075M FY2026, $338M Q1 FY2027, $4.7B authorization left) -- the flat count is well funded; buybacks below IV are accretive and are NOT credited in the model. Possible tariff refunds (~$120M paid) are not modelled. Quarterly CSV labels run one fiscal year behind (CSV 'Q2 2026' = Q1 FY2027, quarter to 2026-06-30).

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: FY2027 revenue guidance midpoint ($5.885B, +7.5%) -- business-cycle adjustment overriding the equity CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR (11.6-12.3%) is less than half of EPS CAGR (25-29%): $2.1B of buybacks over FY2024-26 shrink book value and inflate per-share growth. Revenue CAGRs (15-17%) describe HOKA's hypergrowth phase, which has decelerated to high-single digits (Q1 FY2027 +8%). None of the historical CAGRs is a forward rate; guidance is used instead.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs use the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - equity-award withholding - interest income): FY2021 531.3, FY2023 397.2, FY2026 980.5. The 3-year figure is flattered by FY2023's inventory-build trough. Owner-FCF 5yr CAGR (13.0%) trails reported (14.2%) mostly because interest income on the cash pile grew from $2.6M to $63.6M, not because of SBC, which is modest (~0.8% of revenue). EPS series restated for the 6:1 split of Sep-2024 (FY2021 13.64 -> 2.27).

base.narrative: Guidance year delivered (+7.5%, ~23.4% EBITDA ex-SBC on the 12.5% tariff rate), then HOKA settles into mid-single-digit growth as door expansion and international offset On/Nike share pressure, and UGG holds its year-round diversification without a fad collapse. Margins drift ~1pp below guidance to 22.5% as tariff costs stay structural and DTC store leases grow; cap 13x for a two-brand fashion-exposed business.

bull.narrative: HOKA's H2 FY2027 sporting-goods door expansion re-accelerates the brand to low-double-digit growth, Asia scales both brands, and UGG's sneaker/Tasman lines make it a year-round franchise. Tariff refunds and DTC mix restore margins to the FY2025-26 level (~25.5% EBITDA ex-SBC). Exit at 15x.

bear.narrative: UGG's fashion cycle turns (as it did in FY2012-16) while HOKA loses specialty-run share to On, Nike and Adidas: revenue falls ~9% over FY2028-29 before stabilising at inflation-level growth, with wholesale partners destocking and promotions eroding gross margin. Tariffs stay at 12.5%+ with no refund. EBITDA ex-SBC settles at ~19% -- the FY2022-23 level -- and the business exits at 11x.

scenario_narratives.base: Guidance year delivered, then HOKA settles at mid-single-digit growth as door expansion and Asia offset On/Nike/Adidas competition, and UGG's year-round diversification holds the brand without a fad collapse. Structural tariffs keep margins ~1pp under FY2027 guidance (22.5% EBITDA ex-SBC). The axes are HOKA's share trajectory in performance running and whether UGG's current cycle is a cycle or a platform.
scenario_narratives.bull: HOKA re-accelerates on sporting-goods distribution and international, UGG becomes a year-round lifestyle franchise, and tariff refunds plus DTC mix restore FY2025-26 margins (~25.5%). Revenue compounds ~8% for five years.
scenario_narratives.bear: UGG's fashion cycle rolls over and HOKA's deceleration turns into share loss: revenue falls ~9% over two years, wholesale destocks, promotions and tariffs take EBITDA ex-SBC to ~19% (FY2022-23 level). Two-brand concentration means there is no third leg to cushion it.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: two brands carry ~97% of revenue, UGG has a documented fad history (FY2012-16 decline) and HOKA growth has already fallen from 24-35% to ~8% in four quarters. Base 50% because FY2027 guidance was just raised on EPS and the balance sheet (net cash, no debt) removes any solvency tail. Bull cut to 25% because it needs HOKA re-acceleration, UGG durability and tariff relief to all go right at once.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on a guidance-anchored FY2027 with margins drifting slightly below guidance on structural tariffs. At the anchor price DECK trades near 10.5x FY2027 guided EPS, below its 52-week range midpoint -- the market is pricing something between our base and bear cases, i.e. a UGG/HOKA fade. The valuation turns on brand durability, not on cost of capital or SBC (SBC is <1% of revenue, so house and street bases sit close together).
key_risks_to_valuation: UGG fashion-cycle reversal (FY2012-16 precedent) -- half of revenue
HOKA share loss to On, Nike and Adidas in specialty running
Tariffs on Vietnam/Indonesia sourcing above the 12.5% guided rate; refunds uncertain
Consumer discretionary slowdown hitting wholesale sell-in
Terminal multiple: a 2-point swing in the cap moves base IV by roughly 8%
